<FI> This is<Fi> the word<WH01697> that came unto Jeremiah<WH03414> from the LORD<WH03068>, after<WH0310> that the king<WH04428> Zedekiah<WH06667> had made<WH03772><WTH8800> a covenant<WH01285> with all the people<WH05971> which <FI>were<Fi> at Jerusalem<WH03389>, to proclaim<WH07121><WTH8800> liberty<WH01865> unto them;
